d:
I did this comix as a collaboration with a friend who wrote the story, as an unofficial follow-up to a very well-done comix by fellow creator CaseyKane, and referencing also one obvious classic movie/book.

Because of the original work, this tackles something very different and rather offbeat for me.

Although I DID give it a significant twist at end to be more in line with my preferred take on things, it still references and touches upon a very niche kink which may turn many off, so I am unsure of how much to share in public spaces.

It is only rough pencils, some at the level of very loose layouts at best, others with some more detail, but still never fully finished pencils with ruler-done panel borders and all that. So feel free to downvote/downrate it.

An extensive preview of the original comic KATIA AND THE CHAMELEON that provides preceding events and foundation for this can be found at the creator's deviantart page, CaseyKaneCreations, or in complete form, at the CaseyKane Patreon page. Very recommended, if interested in such kind of material.
